Machinery hire

Tractor and farm machinery hire in Malawi

Our own fleet of farm machinery is available for hire, covering land preparation, planting, spraying, harvesting and irrigation. The equipment is well maintained and every machine is run by one of our experienced operators. We work anywhere in Malawi, so farms, estates and cooperatives can get the work done on time.

Why mechanise

Professional farm machinery, when you need it

In Malawi, preparing one hectare with a hand hoe takes 23–31 person-days; with machinery, including ridging, it takes about 2–2.5 hours. A two-week delay in land preparation can cut maize yields by up to 30%. Book early so your land is ready when the planting rains arrive.

Sources: land-preparation times from Malawi University of Science and Technology / MwAPATA Institute and SIMLESA/CIMMYT; yield loss from Malawi National Planning Commission and UNDP, Malawi 2063 policy brief (2022), citing IFPRI.

What we can do

  • Land preparation

    Disc ploughing, plus subsoiling to break up compacted layers.

How hiring works

  1. Tell us the job

    The operation, field location, area and preferred dates.

  2. Plan and quote

    We recommend the right machines, confirm the schedule and send a quote.

  3. Work in the field

    Our machines and operators arrive on the agreed date and do the work.

  4. Final check

    We check the finished work with you.

We agree the details case by case: the hire period, how charges are calculated (per hectare/acre, per hour or per day), and whether fuel and transport are included. Every machine comes with our own operator, and everything is confirmed in our quote.

Malawi's farming calendar

Malawi has two main cropping seasons: rain-fed crops, mainly maize, in the rainy season, and irrigated winter crops such as wheat in the cool dry season. Land must be prepared before each planting, so that is when demand for machinery peaks.

FAQ

Tractor and machinery hire: common questions

Does a hired tractor come with an operator?

Yes. Every machine we hire out is run by one of our own experienced operators, so you don't need to provide a driver.

How are machinery hire charges calculated?

We quote according to the job, the area and the location: per hectare/acre, per hour or per day. The quote states clearly whether fuel and transport are included.

Which areas of Malawi do you cover?

Anywhere in Malawi. We are based in Lilongwe and can send machines and operators to any part of the country. Tell us where your fields are and we'll confirm the schedule and set out the transport arrangements in our quote.

How far ahead should I book?

As early as possible. Land preparation and planting are our busiest times, so we recommend booking well before the rains start.

Which crops can the combine harvester handle?

Our combine can currently harvest maize, sorghum, wheat, soya beans and rice. Tell us the crop, the area and where your fields are, and we'll confirm a slot and send a quote.
